name: Francis
source:
"Even if there's things I don't know about Yvet's past, I was prepared to accept anything, including things unknown, when I chose her."

Yvet's husband. He was living legit working as a lawyer, but when Yeung Kwun died, he was pulled into a fierce struggle for succession amongst the officers of the Society. He agreed to assume leadership in place of Yeung Kwun on Yvet's support and, 6 months later, he was shot in a nightclub.

[From [url=http://www.rpgdl.org/rsl/en.html#character]official site[/url]]
